summary.text: Ann Matlack is a Democratic state representative from St. George, Maine, who has served in the Maine House since 2018 and is the Democratic candidate for Maine State Senate District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is not seeking re-election to House District 43.

paragraphs.text: Matlack lives in St. George, Maine.
She graduated from Kempsville High School in 1973 and earned a B.S. in education from the University of Maine in 1977.

Her career experience includes working as the assistant to the city manager of the City of Rockland, Maine, as a graduate assistant with the Institute for Public Sector Innovation, and as an executive assistant with International Maritime Systems.
Matlack has served in the Maine House since 2018 and represents District 43, taking office in that term on December 6, 2022.
She chaired the State and Local Government Committee in 2021 and 2022, and in 2023 and 2024 served on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee and the Taxation Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Senate District 12 on June 9, 2026.
